notes.title: Land of War: The Beginning Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

We want to respond to player feedback as soon as possible, so we present to you the content of the patch 1.3, upgrading the version of Land of War to version 1.3.1570 Below you will find a list of fixes introduced in this update.

- Restored Nazi-related symbols, excluding markets where such symbols are forbidden
- New animations for NPC damage and deaths
- Enemies will now drop P08 handgun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/b4760d27f7bcb0531b4f0545b75ef788aefe0fe4.jpg

- Addition od Sturmpistole gun as a free DLC available in main menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/259174bb003c3619291d7413bdad9fcd95404cf8.jpg

- Fixed lighting issues in the last bunker of first mission - Mokra - "The Beginning"
- Improved clouds visuals in "To the Heaven" mission
- Improved fire visuals in Warsaw - "Hold the Line"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/e3660ce2f83ae30a8637153cefaaa19058fc63f0.png

- Added waypoints on swamp passage in Kampinos - "Iron Chest"
- Game no longer crashes when player falls into the water in "Iron Chest" mission
- Fixed ranks on NPC uniforms
- Improved terrain collision above tunnel in "Death from Above" mission
- Added prompt informing player about full equipment when trying to pick a medkit up
- Improved player vehicle sounds in second mission - "Against All Odds"
- Removed Matt's duplicate dialogue in "Dante's Inferno" mission
- Improved UI animations in save menu
- Restored missing forest parts in "Iron Chest" mission
- Fixed issues with projector playback during collectibles inspection
- Improved enemy behaviour during ambush in last mission
- "Death from Above" optimization
- Fixed "Land of War" achievement
- Improved hand animations during opening cutscene
- Fixed bug causing player to get stuck in stationary weapon after dying during exit animation
- Improved sound effects' distances
- Sound memory usage optimized
- Improved collision on bomb craters in Mokra - "Unexpected Visitors"
- Allies hit by player react with damage animations
- Improved sabre collision
- Added new textures for traitors' models in "Hold the Line" mission
- Further improvement of screenshake settings

We hope the update improves your experience with Land of War: The Beginning. Thank you for your trust.

notes.title: Land of War - The Beginning Patch 1.2

- Decreased memory overhead
- Improved particle systems performance on the first mission - The Beginning
- Improved npc rendering performance
- Mission "Hold the Line" - improved npc behaviour during conversations (they look at the player now)
- Fixed “Gunsmith” achievement
- Fixed multiple issues with player’s arms in tankette
- Replaced conversation animations in Iron Chest mission
- Fixed disappearing chests on shooting range
- Fixed collision on small stones
- Fixed issues with plane explosions sounds
- Better placed spawn points for Germans in Unexpected Visitors mission
- Replaced ranks icons for historically accurate
- Changed time outside combat zone from 3 to 5 seconds
- Improved text formatting in tutorials for Russian localization
- Improved texture streaming
- Improved sniper gun sound in Unexpected Visitors mission
- Improved music in Alamo ‘39 mission
- Replaced conversation animations in Death From Above mission
- Fixed issues with QTE while using controllers
- Removed invisible walls on the swamp in Iron Chest mission

- Improved interface scaling

We hope the update improves your experience with Land of War: The Beginning. Thank you for your trust.

notes.title: Land of War - The Beginning patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

The time around the premiere is a time of hard work for us. We collected all the feedback from you, the players, and prepared a patch that will solve most of the urgent issues. 
The patch is called v1.1, the changelog is available below. 

Improvements

• The in-game tutorial for grenades has been added
• The ability to select the force of Camera Shake for the Incoming Hits has been added
• Two game modes have been added – Classic Mode and Casual Mode (reduced damage, faster health regeneration, lower frequency of enemy attacks).
• Several fixes to dialogues have been added to the Hold the Line map
• Dead bodies on the Hold the Line map fixed
• Fixes for handling custom game controllers have been added
• Explosion impact improved

Fixes

• Added option for reversed mouse axis
• Save system improvements
• The behavior of medics on the Hold the Line map has been corrected
• The environment on the Dante’s Inferno map has been improved
• Fixed some visual artifacts on The Beginning map
• The rotation speed of the guns on the armored train has been increased
• Improved camera operation during sequences with an armored train
• The range of combat zones on The Beginning map has been corrected to prevent a death loop at the start of a location
• The Admiral's conversation animation on the English version of The Almo‘39 has been improved
• The behavior of the Admiral on The Almo‘39 has been corrected
• The pyrotechnic effects on the Almo‘39 map have been corrected
• Blocker in the sewer tunnel has been removed (Dante’s Inferno map)
• The size of shield collisions has been corrected in various places in the game
• The movement of the character's mouth on the Hold the Line map has been corrected
• Several dialogue lines have been improved
• The visuals on The Beginning map have been improved - the drawing range of vegetation has been increased
• The lighting on The Beginning map in the bunker has been corrected
• Lighting fixes have been added to the Death from Above map
• Added Amendments to the naming of military ranks in German

We don't want to finish over here, but provide you more updates and continue to collect your feedback. We're aware that some things may have been better here or there, but we're not hiding. In fact, we thank you for all your support and want to improve the game further. More information below.


Patch 1.2 (planned date 16th of June)
 
• Performance and memory usage improvements
• Fire FX improved
• Sound system improvements
• Localisation fixes
• Multiple animations improvements
• Overall balance improvements
• Stability fixes
• Multiple fixes to prevent users to go outside of the map area

We hope that this update will improve your experience with the Land of War game. 
Thank you for supporting us, we’ll continue to bring the updates. 

MS Games Team

notes.title: MS Games’ official statement concerning the delayed release of Land of War
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers, 

The last 48 hours were the most difficult moment for us in the development of Land of War: The Beginning. In our game we wanted to present the most accurate representation of the historical events from the beginning of WW2. Our plans had to be confronted with the legal reality of game publishing. As a private, entity Steam sets standards for content on their platform and is also subject to regulations on all markets, worldwide.

Because of these rules we were obliged to change some of the content in Land of War: The Beginning in the last two days (and nights). The alterations are related to the use of nazi symbols, which in some territories can’t be present in works of fiction (even historical fiction), without an approval of proper authorities. The game has again been submitted again for review by Steam. After receiving approval it will be available for players as soon as possible. We will inform you about the new release date in a separate message. In the meantime we are working on a patch, which will restore the removed imagery in territories where the law allows their presence in a proper context.

In the last days we received a lot of support from the community, but also some criticism. The last three years have been a period of hard work, and the last few days were highly intense. We want Land of War to reach you as fast as possible and want to apologize for the inconvenience.


On behalf of MS Games
Sebastian Binik

notes.title: Land of War - release date change. Details soon.
notes.notes:
We would like to inform you that Land of War: The Beginning will not be released today. The game is complete and playable from start to finish, however it contained symbols prohibited in Germany. The revised version has been already submitted for review and tomorrow (May 28th) we will inform you about the new release date. All factors considered, we are planning for the delay to be as minor as possible. The entire team at MS Games would like to apologize to all the players and assure that soon they will be able to get their hands on the studio’s passion-project.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/7caeeb6836013fe6b613b43645c3d470f39bdbc7.png

We will distribute review codes as soon as the game passes the review process.

Best regards/ On behalf of MS Games
Sebastian Binik

Available DLCs:

VIS P-35!
This is the German version of the legendary Polish wz. 35 VIS. After taking over the F.B. Radom factory, the Wehrmacht resumed production in 1940 under the name P-35(p) removing the Polish emblem and the year of production. In total the occupants produced 312,000 pieces in several versions, which were gradually simplified.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/3c6df6b432e1bcc97de8d13e01acaa08dc5cd20c.png
 A small number of the pistols were manufactured in Poland, under conspiratorial conditions, from parts taken from the factory, with the barrels being made in the workshops of the Home Army in Warsaw.

Thompson wz.28!
Add the Thompson submachine gun wz.28 to your equipment!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/52277b3308cd8e8e9ce37883aba5e2aa7562d1d2.png
In the mid of the 1920s Poland purchased about 100 Thompson wz. 1921/3 (wz. 1928) for the National Police. In 1936 16 pieces were handed over for use in the Border Protection Corps. The weapon was used in the 1939 defensive war and later in partisan battle.

Revolver Nagant wz. NG 30!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35748898/51bda00184e7c5274a4a25412875e90f14f679d2.png
It was a weapon produced in Poland by F.B. Radom under a licence bought in Belgium. 19,000 pieces were produced, of which 15,700 went into the armament of the National Police.

Saber wz.1921!
It was introduced into the army in 1921 and used until 1939 as individual armament for soldiers of the mounted artillery squadrons, light artillery regiments, squadrons of the Border Protection Corps, tabors and “Krakus” divisional cavalry.
